description: Main source file for a Zephyr-based sensor application on the SensorTile.box platform, initializing and reading multiple sensors, handling triggers, and displaying sensor data.

methods.name: lps22hh_config
methods.description: Configures the LPS22HH sensor, sets sampling frequency, and optionally sets trigger handler.

methods.name: lis2dw12_config
methods.description: Configures the LIS2DW12 sensor, sets sampling frequency and full scale, and optionally sets trigger handler.

methods.name: lsm6dso_config
methods.description: Configures the LSM6DSO sensor, sets accelerometer and gyroscope sampling frequencies, full scale, and trigger handlers.

methods.name: stts751_config
methods.description: Configures the STTS751 temperature sensor, sets conversion rate, and optionally sets trigger handler.

methods.name: iis3dhhc_config
methods.description: Configures the IIS3DHHC accelerometer sensor, sets sampling frequency, and optionally sets trigger handler.
